message:
All tests pass now: 2 of 2.

The bug was in `src/vat.js`. `withVat` used `Math.floor(pence * 1.2)`, which truncates instead of rounding. The comment on the function says "rounded to the nearest penny", and the failing test expected `withVat(999)` to be `1199`, but the truncated result was `1198`. I changed it to `Math.round(pence * 1.2)`.

The change is a one-line edit to `src/vat.js`. I didn't commit it.
